items.title: qm
items.description: Multiplayer agent harness for work
items.summary: QM is an open-source multiplayer agent harness for work, designed for startups, providing isolated workspaces for each employee and supporting multiple AI coding tools. It runs in Slack and on the web, with shared org-wide capabilities.

items.title: crm
items.description: An open-source, agentic-first CRM.
items.summary: An open-source, agentic-first CRM is available under MIT license, built with durable research agents, and uses technologies like Next.js and PostgreSQL. It emphasizes agent-driven operations and is self-hostable or serverless.

items.title: kimi-k3-in-c
items.description: A 2.78-trillion-parameter Kimi K3 running inference on a single CPU in 8.24 GB of RAM. Portable C99: no BLAS, no framework, no GPU.
items.summary: Kimi K3 is a 2.8 trillion parameter model running inference on a single CPU with 8.24 GB RAM, using no BLAS, framework, or GPU. It's memory-efficient due to a mixture-of-experts architecture. It was released in 2026.

items.title: anatomy
items.description: An interactive 3D human anatomy explorer built using threejs with GPT 5.6 Sol
items.summary: An interactive 3D human anatomy explorer was developed using threejs and GPT 5.6 Sol. It is hosted on GitHub and showcases educational tools. The project is maintained by The Bugged Dev.

items.title: genoffice
items.description: An AI-native office suite for macOS and Windows: word processor, spreadsheet, presentations, and PDF.
items.summary: GenOffice is an open-source AI office suite for macOS and Windows. It includes word processing, spreadsheets, presentations, and PDF editing. It's free and ad-free.

items.title: deltafin
items.description: Run full Kimi K3 on a single device. And an OpenAI-compatible API server for local chat and coding agents.
items.summary: Deltafin enables running the Kimi K3 model locally with an API compatible with OpenAI. It requires significant hardware resources and can be run on a rented GPU cluster. The model is served via an API endpoint.

items.title: ponytail-improved
items.description: Makes your AI agent think like the laziest senior dev in the room. The best code is the code you never wrote.
items.summary: Ponytail makes AI coding agents prioritize minimal code, leveraging existing solutions and avoiding unnecessary features. It embodies the principle that the best code is the code you never wrote.

items.title: humanizer-cli
items.description: 33 ways to spot AI-written text, right in your terminal. Before/after examples, draft checker, zero dependencies.
items.summary: Humanizer-CLI detects AI-written text and improves writing to avoid detection, offering before/after examples and zero dependencies. It includes a command-line interface for analyzing and humanizing content.

items.title: ratchet
items.description: Your agent reads the rules. This checks whether it followed them.
items.summary: Ratchet refers to a pattern ensuring sequential processing of items, with each item passing before the next opens. It emphasizes compliance with rules and quality checks. The concept is used in agent-based systems to ensure tasks are completed in order.

items.title: ai-design-skills
items.summary: AI design skills focus on systems thinking, visual polish, and AI fluency for effective product design. Essential skills include crafting prototypes and translating complexity into clarity. Designers must document problem-solving approaches for guided AI.

items.title: starling
items.description: Starling — a new Linux desktop environment: Swift shell, its own compositor, a Flutter-to-Swift framework port, and first-party apps
items.summary: Starling is a new Linux desktop environment built in Swift, featuring its own Wayland compositor and X11 server, developed largely with AI assistance. It includes a shell, window manager, and first-party apps. It's still in development with some rough edges.

items.title: context-ontology-accelerator
items.description: An open-source, ontology-based semantic context accelerator that enables AI agents to make more accurate, consistent, and explainable decisions.
items.summary: The context-ontology-accelerator is an open-source tool that uses ontology to help AI agents make better decisions. It is maintained by AWS and integrates with various BI tools and AI frameworks. It aims to improve decision accuracy and consistency.

items.title: geolook
items.description: Open-source end-to-end GEO implementation: status analysis, diagnosis, strategy, tickets, execution, verification
items.summary: GeoLook is an open-source GEO implementation platform. It requires cloning, installing dependencies, and running scripts. GEO optimization involves strategic diagnosis and execution, ensuring schema markup is correctly implemented.

items.title: codex-vision-proxy
items.description: 让纯文本模型在 Codex 中无障碍调用内置看图工具（view_image）的方案，附为纯文本 LLM 设计的视觉工具包&skill ｜  Let text-only models call Codex's built-in view_image seamlessly, plus a vision toolkit&skill designed for text-only LLMs.
items.summary: Codex-vision-proxy enables text-only models to seamlessly call Codex's view_image tool. It includes a vision toolkit for text-only LLMs. This solution integrates vision capabilities directly into text-based models.

items.title: trace-file-lineage
items.description: Find which script, notebook, data, command, or AI agent produced a file — locally, with evidence and honest uncertainty.
items.summary: To trace file lineage, use a tool that records provenance and version control information. The tool can identify the script, notebook, or command that produced the file. This method provides verifiable evidence of the file's origin.

items.title: toolknit-desktop
items.description: 多功能工具箱 · 桌面端开源版 | 音视频/图片/PDF/AI 一站式处理
items.summary: Toolknit-desktop is an open-source tool for desktop that processes audio, video, images, PDFs, and AI tasks. It is maintained by ZihangDong. It offers a one-stop solution for various multimedia and AI functionalities.

items.title: time-to-first-token
items.description: A 10-week, 30-minutes-a-day roadmap for LLM inference serving and optimization. vLLM, SGLang, quantization, speculative decoding, benchmarking.
items.summary: Time-to-first-token is a key metric for LLM inference optimization, focusing on latency from request to first output token. Techniques like quantization and speculative decoding can significantly reduce this time. A 10-week roadmap can achieve substantial improvements using these methods.

items.title: ai-sdk
items.description: Grafana AI SDK for Go — streaming, tool-calling AI backends that speak fluent @ai-sdk/react
items.summary: The AI SDK Grafana Go SDK provides streaming interfaces for AI applications, enabling real-time updates from AI tools to React components. It supports tool-calling backends and integrates with React for dynamic, data-rich interfaces.

items.title: awesome-free-ai-course-notes
items.description: A curated collection of machine learning and AI lecture notes from the world's leading universities.  This repository gives you access to the same lecture notes used by students at top institutions such as MIT, helping you learn from the very best educational resources available.
items.summary: The term "awesome-free-ai-course-notes" refers to a collection of machine learning and AI lecture notes from top universities like MIT. It offers access to high-quality educational resources. The repository aims to provide the best learning materials available.

items.title: super-simple-software-factory
items.description: Repeatable agents-plus-code workflows, packaged as one skill, stamped into any repo. Deterministic Python owns the graph; coding agents are bounded nodes inside it.
items.summary: A software factory uses AI coding agents to automate software development, ensuring repeatable, high-quality processes. Python manages the workflow graph, while agents act as bounded nodes. This approach scales from single to multiple agents for efficient, automated code production.

items.title: nuyoah-xiezhen-prompt
items.description: 南鸢写真提示词 Agent Skill
items.summary: The nuyoah-xiezhen-prompt is an AI skill for generating photography prompts. It is hosted on GitHub and designed for photo and portrait photography. It is part of the nuyoah-ai-works project.

items.title: mcpx
items.description: MCPX 是运行在开发环境中的 MCP Runtime（网关）。ChatGPT、Claude、Cursor、Grok 及其他支持 Streamable HTTP 的 MCP 客户端，可以通过统一工具面理解项目、查看 Unified Diff、修改源码、运行任务、采集环境信息，并调用本地 MCP 与 Skill。
items.summary: MCPX is an open-source runtime for managing AI coding tools. It centralizes access and syncs configurations across various clients. Built by a team at Amazon, it ensures secure and governed tool usage.

items.title: qiaomu-seo
items.description: Audit, diagnose, research, plan, implement, experiment on, and verify website SEO across Google, Bing, and AI-search surfaces. Use for technical SEO,
items.summary: An SEO audit checks website technical details, content quality, and AI visibility for search rankings. It includes technical SEO, AI search engine optimization, and competitor analysis. The audit helps improve search engine performance and AI discoverability.

items.title: doc7
items.description: Turn documents into AI-ready Markdown with visual understanding
items.summary: Markdown enhances AI applications by providing clean, structured data that improves accuracy and reduces noise. It preserves document hierarchy and formatting, making it ideal for AI training and content management. Markdown simplifies complex documents into a format that AI systems can easily interpret.

items.title: aimux
items.description: Unified LLM access layer in Rust — one API for 325 AI providers. 统一 LLM 服务接入层：一套 API 接入 325 家 AI 服务商。
items.summary: Aimux Unified LLM access layer in Rust provides a single API for 325 AI providers, simplifying integration and management. It supports major providers like OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google, with open-source, scalable solutions.

items.title: bindwidth
items.description: Evidence-aware on-prem LLM inference sizing and TCO calculator
items.summary: Memory bandwidth is crucial for LLM inference; hardware sizing and TCO depend on performance benchmarks and model parameters. Use calculators for detailed cost and performance estimates.

items.title: DeterminFlow
items.description: A production-oriented AI workflow runtime for building, validating, recovering, and shipping complex AI workflows as dependable services. 面向生产的 AI 工作流运行时：快速开发、验证和恢复复杂 AI 工作流，并将其稳定交付为服务。
items.summary: DeterminFlow is a production-oriented AI workflow runtime for building, validating, and shipping complex AI workflows efficiently. It ensures stable delivery of AI services by managing complex processes. It uses a modular approach to reduce operational costs and improve efficiency.

items.title: Super-Instruct-Codex-5.6
items.description: 针对GPT 5.6的破甲实验项目，基于Rust开发
items.summary: GPT-5.6 is an advanced AI model developed by Amazon, focusing on enhanced performance and efficiency. It utilizes the Codex framework for programming tasks and integrates with various tools for development. Its capabilities include high-speed processing and reduced costs compared to previous models.

items.title: dscode
items.description: Coding agent powered by DeepSeek.
items.summary: DeepSeek Coding Agent is a terminal-based AI tool that assists in coding tasks, and DeepSeek-TUI is its open-source version that gained popularity on GitHub. It supports file editing, shell commands, and Git operations directly in the terminal.

items.title: vibe-astock
items.description: A 股短线复盘看板：涨停池·连板梯队·龙虎榜·板块资金一屏看完，赚钱效应/晋级率/梯队断层/情绪周期等派生指标纯计算直出（不经过 AI），AI 只把数据串成能读的盘面研判。全本地运行，可用 Claude/Codex 订阅免 API key。| A-share short-term daily-review dashboard: derived sentiment metrics computed locally, AI only writes the narrative. No API key needed.
items.summary: Vibe-Astock provides a local dashboard for A-share short-term trading analysis. It computes derived sentiment metrics without AI. No API key is needed for use.

items.title: poirot
items.description: Poirot is a deep research agent kernel built for those who care about how agents are architected.
items.summary: Poirot is an advanced deep research agent architecture designed for failure detection in multi-agent systems, showing superior performance in complex, safety-critical domains. It uses a hybrid communication protocol and iterative exploration for sustained attention. Poirot represents a step towards self-auditing AI systems.

items.title: databricks-ai-bootcamp-capstone
items.summary: The Databricks AI Boot Camp requires capstone submission by August 9th, 2026, for certification and rewards. The boot camp covers Databricks skills and AI features. It includes a capstone project with feedback and support.

items.title: awplanet
items.description: AI 原生 3D 导演工作台与场景创作工具 / AI-native 3D direction and scene creation studio
items.summary: awplanet is an AI-native 3D direction and scene creation studio. It offers visual scene editing, character controls, and virtual production tools. It supports macOS and Windows.

items.title: canivibecodeit
items.description: Find out which subscriptions are one prompt away from free. caniuse.com, but for replacing SaaS with one AI prompt.
items.summary: Free AI tools like ChatGPT and Ubersuggest can replace expensive SaaS subscriptions. Many businesses and solopreneurs are cutting costs by switching to these alternatives. In 2026, AI tools are often free and perform well.

items.title: literature-review-agent
items.description: A LangGraph-powered agent for literature search, evidence screening, outline generation, and evidence-grounded review writing.
items.summary: LangGraph is a framework for building agents that orchestrate tasks through a state graph, enabling fine-grained control over workflows. It uses nodes and edges to represent tasks and their sequences. LangGraph is popular for its visual and clear structure in managing complex processes.

items.title: awesome-open-llms
items.description: 开源模型汇总，每月更新现在主流的开源模型。A monthly tracker for the latest and most popular open-source AI models.
items.summary: The latest open-source AI models are tracked monthly on GitHub and updated regularly. GLM-5.2 from Z.ai is a top-rated model known for its coding and reasoning capabilities. It has 753 billion parameters and a 1 million token context.

items.title: AsterMem
items.description: Self-hosted memory service for AI assistants
items.summary: AsterMem is a self-hosted memory service for AI assistants, storing data locally without cloud sync. It uses SQLite and Markdown for storage. It offers a single API endpoint for AI agents.

items.title: Qwen-CUA
items.description: Qwen-CUA: Native Computer Use for (Almost) Everything — a screenshot-driven agent that operates computers with keyboard and mouse, jointly developed by the Qwen Team and XLang Lab.
items.summary: Qwen-CUA is a computer-use agent that operates via screenshots and a virtual mouse/keyboard, achieving state-of-the-art performance in computer and web browsing tasks. It integrates perception, reasoning, and action iteratively.

items.title: kaas
items.description: Turn scattered notes, docs and transcripts into a queryable Markdown wiki — an LLM knowledge-base compiler with MCP access, no embeddings, self-hosted.
items.summary: The LLM Wiki compiles knowledge into interlinked markdown files for easy querying, unlike traditional retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) that fetches raw chunks on each query. It uses a coding agent to update only affected pages.

items.title: axern
items.description: Open-source sandboxes for AI agents, untrusted code execution, and durable services.
items.summary: E2B is an open-source sandbox for secure AI code execution using microVMs. Vercel Sandbox offers isolated environments for untrusted code. Modal provides persistent, fast-resuming sandboxes for AI agents.

items.title: zhixin-companion
items.description: 面向个人自我记录、复盘和认知梳理的伙伴型-提示词及agent配置文件：从具体线索出发，区分事实、感受和解释，在共情的同时保留现实检验。
items.summary: Zhixin-companion is a tool for personal self-reflection, based on separating facts, feelings, and explanations while maintaining realistic checks. It is not a replacement for professional advice and should not be used for crisis intervention. It is source-available but not open source.

items.title: VideoCoCo
items.description: Code-as-CoT for Physically-Consistent Video Generation via an Agentic Dual-Engine System
items.summary: VideoCoCo is a dual-engine framework for generating physically consistent videos using Blender code as an intermediate representation. It achieved high physical consistency scores and outperforms existing models. The framework separates dynamic reasoning from visual realization.

items.title: apexcli
items.description: Apex Foundation is a Web3 accelerator and investor.  200+ portfolio companies. $100K–$500K direct checks. This is where  we share what we learn screening projects, what separates funded  from rejected, and what's actually happening in Web3 infrastructure,  DeFi, and AI on-chain. No hype, no price talk.
items.summary: Apexcli is a Web3 accelerator investing $100K–$500K in over 200 portfolio companies, focusing on DeFi and AI on-chain. They provide insights on project screening and Web3 infrastructure. Their direct checks are a key differentiator in funding decisions.

items.title: alpha_agentic_search
items.description: Alpha Agentic Search — 分层记忆 RAG 检索问答系统
items.summary: Agentic RAG uses multiple agents to dynamically select information sources, supports multi-round searches, and offers more flexible and intelligent reasoning compared to traditional RAG. It is suited for complex tasks requiring multiple tools and real-time data.

items.title: finger-frame-effect-ai
items.summary: The finger-frame effect uses AI to generate a stylized world inside a video frame created by hand gestures. It's a viral video editing technique. The effect can be applied using specific tools and techniques.

items.title: SottoQR
items.description: During the July 2024 uprising, fake and manipulated images obscured the truth, making it difficult to verify evidence or track justice. Our AI powered platform authenticates images, preserves credible evidence & transparently tracks case progress, helping protect historical truth during crises and beyond.
items.summary: AI tools can sometimes misidentify authentic images as fake, complicating efforts to verify evidence. This issue highlights the need for improved AI image detection accuracy. Efforts to combat fake images are crucial for maintaining historical truth.

items.title: InduSecAgent
items.summary: InduSecAgent None refers to a database option to add a "None" selection in dropdown lists. Induce Non-Ionic Surfactant is a product for improving spray coverage. Induce Madness is a DnD spell for causing madness.

items.title: hbg-life-simulation
items.description: HBG Agent Skill for Chinese life-simulation narrative videos with consistent comic IP, rapid multi-life openings, Edge TTS, synchronized captions, zoom/pan motion and final MP4 QA.
items.summary: The HBG Agent Skill enables Chinese life-simulation videos with rapid multi-life openings, Edge TTS, synchronized captions, and zoom/pan motion. It integrates seamlessly into long videos and maintains high-quality MP4 output. The skill has been validated through extensive testing.

items.title: Claude-Opus-5-Free-Desktop
items.description: Claude Opus 5 free desktop  Anthropic's flagship on Windows, macOS, Linux. Claude Fable 5 vs Opus 5 and Opus 4.8 comparison panel built in. Claude Sonnet 5 vs Fable 5 vs Opus 4.8 benchmarks shown. Claude Fable 5 vs Mythos 5 vs Opus 4.8 vs GPT 5 . Claude Opus 5 release date access now download free.
items.summary: Anthropic has not released a model named Claude Opus 5. The latest Opus model is Claude Opus 4.8. The model above Opus is Claude Fable 5.

items.title: equipdoc-agent
items.description: Auditable AI agent for electromechanical maintenance with LangGraph, RAG, fault diagnosis and human-in-the-loop review.
items.summary: Equipdoc-agent uses AI for predictive maintenance, fault diagnosis, and integrates human-in-the-loop reviews. It employs LangGraph and RAG for complex workflows. The agent enhances traditional maintenance methods with advanced AI techniques.
